scenario: You are volunteering at a community garden. The garden coordinator is explaining how the garden is run. Listen to the coordinator and repeat what the coordinator says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Each family is given its own small plot.
The tools are stored in the shed by the gate.
Please water the vegetable beds early in the morning or evening.
If you see any weeds, pull them out before they spread.
Volunteers who help on weekends can take home some of the vegetables.
When the compost bin gets full, move it to the back corner.
